findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "get_my_watchlist" references sensitive artifacts (authorization, bearer, session token). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: cluster_context · Private data: get_my_watchlist · Public sink: graph_neighbors, portfolio_analyze, cluster_context.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: cluster_context · Private data: get_my_watchlist · Public sink: graph_neighbors, portfolio_analyze, cluster_context

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_smart_list_metrics" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
